oe_ttb_buy_peace = {
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = { scope:actor = { oe_ttb_can_offer = yes } }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        looking_for_a = country
        target_flag = target_country
        name = "oe_ttb_buy_peace_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_ttb_buy_peace_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = yes }
        enabled = { custom_tooltip = { text = oe_ttb_refused_tt NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_refused } } }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world }
                scope:actor = { oe_ttb_can_offer = yes }
                exists = scope:target_country
                scope:target_country = { oe_ttb_peace_target_ok = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_ttb_refused } }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_ttb_buy_peace_tt
            hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { set_variable = { name = oe_ttb_offer value = scope:target_country } oe_ttb_send_envoy = yes } }
        }
    }
}
